tools.name: lookup_wallet
tools.description: Look up an Ethereum wallet: ETH balance, contract flag, outbound tx count, and simple risk heuristics (ok / new_wallet / contract / eip7702). EIP-7702 delegated EOAs report risk=eip7702. Read-only; not an AML score.

tools.name: lookup_nft
tools.description: Resolve NFT metadata for a contract + tokenId: name, description, image HTTP URL, IPFS gateway link, and raw metadata JSON. Supports ERC-721 and ERC-1155. Read-only.
